# Oiltech Bearings

> Oiltech Bearings Ltd is a UK-based manufacturer specialising in whitemetal, white metal and Babbitt lined bearings for steam turbines, pumps, compressors, gearboxes, and other rotating equipment. These terms refer to the same family of soft bearing alloys. Services include new bearing manufacture, repair and re-lining, re-engineering of obsolete or problem bearings, bearing design and analysis, and OEM supply. Based in Newcastle upon Tyne, serving customers worldwide.

## Services

- [Whitemetal Bearing Repair](https://oiltechbrg.com/whitemetal-bearing-repair/): Stripping, re-lining and refurbishment with ultrasonic bond testing to ISO 4386-1 and dye penetrant testing to ISO 4386-3
- [Re-Engineering](https://oiltechbrg.com/re-engineering/): Redesign of obsolete, underperforming, or failure-prone bearings using modern materials and analysis
- [Bearing Design and Analysis](https://oiltechbrg.com/bearing-design-analysis/): Thermo-hydrodynamic (THD) analysis, rotor-dynamic studies, and bespoke bearing design
- [Technical Services](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-services/): Engineering support, site investigation, and troubleshooting for bearing problems
- [Bearing Technical Library](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/): Developing technical hub for whitemetal bearing failure analysis, design, lubrication, inspection, repair, materials and installation
- [Bearing Rules of Thumb](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-rules-of-thumb/): Technician quick-reference values for Babbitt temperature, journal clearance, surface finish, lubrication, inspection standards, conversions and preliminary calculators
- [Bearing Terminology](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-terminology/): Searchable glossary distinguishing whitemetal, Babbitt, sleeve, journal, thrust, fluid-film, hydrodynamic and related bearing terms
- [Hydrodynamic Lubrication](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/hydrodynamic-lubrication/): How speed, lubricant viscosity and converging geometry generate a load-carrying film in journal and thrust bearings
- [Whitemetal Bearing Lining Thickness Guide](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/whitemetal-bearing-thickness-guide/): Finished Babbitt lining thickness, fatigue and embedability trade-offs, published application examples, repair measurements, inspection thresholds and a cylindrical journal lining calculator
- [Bearing Failure Analysis](https://oiltechbrg.com/bearing-failure-modes/): Damage index and structured root-cause investigation process for common whitemetal bearing failures

## Bearing Failure Guides

- [Bearing Fatigue Failure](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/fatigue/): Fatigue cracking, cyclic load investigation and corrective action
- [Oil Starvation and Wiping](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/oil-starvation-wiping/): Oil-film collapse, wiped lining and lubrication-system investigation
- [Black Scab and Wire Wool Damage](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/black-scab-wire-wool/): Embedded hard particles, shaft machining and contamination control
- [Contamination and Scoring](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/contamination-scoring/): Debris paths, scored lining and oil-system cleanliness
- [Misalignment Damage](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/misalignment/): Edge loading, geometry checks and alignment correction
- [Electrical Discharge Damage](https://oiltechbrg.com/technical-library/bearing-failure/electrical-discharge/): Pitting, spark tracking, shaft current and grounding checks

## Common Bearing Questions

- What does Oiltech Bearings manufacture? Oiltech manufactures, repairs, re-lines and re-engineers whitemetal lined hydrodynamic bearings for turbines, pumps, compressors, gearboxes, fans and other rotating equipment.
- Are whitemetal, white metal and Babbitt bearings the same? Yes. These are common names for a plain bearing with a soft tin-based or lead-based alloy bonded to a stronger backing and designed to run on an oil film.
- Can Oiltech repair babbitt bearings? Yes. Oiltech strips, inspects, re-lines, machines and verifies whitemetal/babbitt bearings when the backing component is suitable for repair.
- Can Oiltech reverse engineer bearings without drawings? Yes. Oiltech can work from samples, housings, damaged parts, partial drawings or general arrangement information to create production drawings and new bearings.
- Why do thrust bearings fail repeatedly? Common causes include high oil film temperature, inadequate oil film thickness, excessive load, poor pad alignment, unsuitable pivot geometry, contamination, oil starvation and misalignment.
- How does bearing re-engineering improve reliability? Re-engineering can change pad geometry, pivot position, materials, oil feed, clearances and heat transfer to reduce temperature and increase oil film thickness.
